label: S. 4668
title: Protect College Sports Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill establishes requirements for name, image, or likeness (NIL) agreements for college student athletes and provides a limited antitrust exemption for schools and conferences to pool and sell certain college sports media rights.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
